answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, held in escrow until finality, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The river of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The kernel holds work receipts rather than names, so the horizon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
